title: Move the close usage record to .bee/usage/<feature>.json
action: Relocate the green-close usage record from docs/history/<feature>/usage.json to .bee/usage/<feature>.json so it lives in bee's own store and is committed by close's .bee-scoped bookkeeping auto-commit
description: In close.rs, change write_usage_record (added by close-usage-record, commit 38550b0e) so the record lands at .bee/usage/<feature>.json under the CONTROL root's .bee (the same root resolution the sessions read uses — for a worktree close the record must land in the main checkout's .bee, mirror how collect_close_usage resolves control_root_for), creating .bee/usage/ as needed; keep schema bee-usage/v1, the record shape, the close-result usage_record relative path field (now .bee/usage/<feature>.json), and the letter Token usage section exactly as they are. Update the function's doc comment: the close-time bookkeeping auto-commit stages .bee (git add -A -- .bee), so the record is committed by close itself now — no merge dependency; verify .bee/usage/ is NOT matched by .gitignore (only .bee/logs/ and friends are ignored) and say so in the cap report. Remove the docs/history write entirely — no file, no fallback. Update every test that asserted the docs/history path to assert the .bee/usage path instead; keep the empty-but-skipped-still-written behavior and its test. If any doc or knowledge file in the repo names docs/history/<feature>/usage.json as the record home, list those paths in the cap report as follow-up rather than editing them (docs sweep is not this cell).
acceptance: A green bee close writes .bee/usage/<feature>.json (control root) and no docs/history usage.json; close's own bookkeeping commit covers it; usage_record in the close JSON names the new path; scoped cargo tests green.
judge_obligation_ack: touches close.rs and mailbox.rs only — no hook-guard source in files
